title: Answer: the universe began as a deliberate vibration of a 9D source with free will

statements.text: The first cause was not a random singularity but a deliberate vibratory impulse from a 9D causal entity, the Source, possessing free will. It split the pre-spacetime void into three interlocking domains, the Manifest, the Interface and the Template, a closed loop that conserves information.

sources.quote: a deliberate vibratory impulse initiated by a 9D Causal Entity (The Source) possessing Free Will
